notes.subject: זרזיר
notes.rationale: Occurs only here in the Tanakh; 'tightly girt of loins' — identity unknown

notes.subject: זרזיר
notes.rationale: Renderings differ: greyhound (KJV), strutting rooster (BSB, following later Hebrew), horse, or a fleet animal — the Hebrew literally says only 'girt-of-loins'

notes.subject: אלקום
notes.rationale: Occurs only here; 'a non-rising', i.e. one against whom none rises up

translation: Kɔ-datugulen (min bɛ a kɔ-kɔrɔtɔ mara), walima ba-cɛ; ani masakɛ min bɛɛ tɛ se ka jungun a nɔ na.

tokens.gloss: min bɛɛ tɛ se ka jungun
